questions.q: Who are named with Paul at the start of the letter?
What had the Thessalonians turned away from in order to serve God?
In which regions had the Thessalonians become an example to believers?
What does Paul say he knows about the brothers loved by God?
Remembering without ceasing your work of faith and ____ and perseverance of hope.
To wait for his Son from heaven: Jesus, who delivers us from ____.
In every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that ____.

items: Thanks and prayers for all of them
The Good News came in power and the Spirit
They became an example in Macedonia and Achaia
They turned to God from idols

questions.q: Paul says the Thessalonians became imitators of him and of the Lord.
Paul says the Thessalonians received the word in a season of peace and quiet.
Where had Paul and his companions been shamefully treated before coming to Thessalonica?
Why did Paul and his companions work night and day while preaching?
options: So they would not burden anyone
To pay for their next journey
To give money to the poor
Because they were forbidden to preach

questions.q: Who does Paul say hindered him from coming back to them?
What does Paul call the Thessalonians before the Lord Jesus at his coming?
options: His hope, joy, and crown of rejoicing

questions.q: We were gentle among you, like ____ cherishes her own children.
You accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, ____.
Neither were we at any time found using ____, nor a cloak of covetousness.

items: Bold to speak despite much conflict
Not seeking glory from men
Behaving holy and blamelessly toward believers
Longing to see their faces again

questions.q: Paul says he insisted on his authority as an apostle while he was with them.
Paul says the Thessalonians suffered from their own countrymen, as the churches in Judea did.
Whom did Paul send to establish and comfort the Thessalonians?
Where did Paul decide to be left behind alone?
What did Paul fear might have happened to them?
options: They had been driven from the city

questions.q: According to the report Paul received, what did they always have of him?
For now we live, if you ____.
At the coming of our Lord Jesus ____.
Praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is ____.

items: Thanksgiving for all the joy over them
Praying night and day to see them
Asking God to direct their way there
Asking that they abound in love

questions.q: Paul says he was comforted in his distress through the Thessalonians' faith.
Paul says he told them beforehand that believers would be spared from affliction.
What does Paul say is the will of God for them in this chapter?
Why does Paul say there is no need to write them about brotherly love?
options: They are taught by God to love
They read it in the scriptures

questions.q: Who will rise first when the Lord descends from heaven?
What sounds accompany the Lord's descent from heaven?
options: A shout, the archangel's voice, God's trumpet
Thunder, a shout, and seven trumpets
A trumpet, singing, and loud thunder
The archangel's voice, harps, and a trumpet

questions.q: So that you don't grieve like the rest, ____.
Make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and ____.
questions.answer: to work with your own hands

questions.q: Then we who are alive will be caught up together with them ____ to meet the Lord in the air.

items: Please God and abound more and more
Control your body in holiness and honor
Don't wrong a brother in this matter
Walk properly toward those outside

questions.q: Paul says those alive at the Lord's coming will not go ahead of those who have died.
Paul says whoever rejects this teaching on holiness rejects man, not God.
How does Paul say the day of the Lord comes?
options: Like a thief in the night
Like a flood over the earth

questions.q: What will people be saying when sudden destruction comes on them?
What does Paul describe as the believer's helmet?
What does Paul tell them to do for the faint hearted?
You are all children of light and ____.
Test all things, and ____.
questions.answer: hold firmly that which is good

questions.q: May your whole ____ be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

items: Always rejoice
Pray without ceasing
In everything give thanks
Don't quench the Spirit

questions.q: Paul tells them they need detailed teaching about the times and the seasons.
Paul solemnly commands that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
